thread.title: Utah student-athletes achieve record GPA for 2025-26 academic year
thread.title_full: Utah student-athletes achieve record GPA for 2025-26 academic year

author: beehive state news
title: Utah student-athletes achieve record GPA for 2025-26 academic year
text:
Utah’s student-athletes achieved a new department record with a combined grade-point average of 3.441 for the 2025-26 academic year, surpassing the previous record of 3.407 set in the 2020-21 year, according to a May 20 announcement.
This achievement highlights ongoing academic success among Utah’s athletes, who have now posted a departmental GPA of at least 3.00 for forty consecutive semesters. The spring semester average GPA reached 3.465, ranking as the second highest in school history and paired with a fall GPA of 3.418, which is now fourth all-time.
“Congratulations to our incredible student-athletes for their record-setting academic performance during the 2025-26 school year,” said Mark Harlan, Director of Athletics. “It is a tremendous accomplishment to continue to raise the bar the way they have, while competing at the highest level athletically, and making such an impact in our community. I’d also like to credit the work of our excellent coaches, staff, academic services team and our campus partners for the way they contribute to the culture of excellence in Utah Athletics that positions our students for success in the classroom, competition and community.” The women’s cross-country team led all sports with a spring semester GPA of 3.749 after finishing in the top twenty at NCAA Championships for five straight years. On the men’s side, skiing earned its twelfth consecutive semester as top performer with a spring GPA of 3.737.
Additional highlights from Spring 2026 include fifty-eight student-athletes earning perfect GPAs; two hundred twenty-two named to Dean’s List (GPA above 3.50); and three hundred eighty-eight making Athletic Director’s Honor Roll (GPA above or equal to 3.00). Program-specific milestones were also reported: women’s gymnastics has maintained at least a team GPA of 3.00 for sixty-two semesters; men’s skiing, women’s cross-country and volleyball have each done so for thirty-six semesters; men’s skiing (GPA: 3.737) and baseball (GPA: 3.538) posted program records; football achieved its best mark since Spring 2020 with a GPA of 3.359.
Athletic accomplishments continued alongside academics: one national championship was secured by Utah Skiing—its seventh title in nine seasons—and four conference titles were won by three programs this year so far.
Ninety-nine current or former athletes earned degrees from Utah over this past year as well; according to recent NCAA Graduation Success Rate data provided by university officials, ninety-five percent graduated within six years—tying an all-time high mark reached three times overall and matching last year’s figure.
